summary.content:
Today's selection covers 72 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 44 on Artificial Intelligence and 4 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Google finally releases Gemini 4 Argon
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Prominent Ransomware Negotiator Faces Extortion Charges
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 46 articles published in the last 24 hours
